description: Weighted checklist of the remaining Saya no Uta web port work. Read by scripts/progress-report.mjs. Weights sum to 100. Status is done, partial (partial = credit 0..1, default 0.5) or todo. Items with auto.proof take their status from the matching re/verification proof instead; their status field is ignored.

rules.auto: proof is a glob relative to the repo root (* within a name, ** for any folders), searched under re/verification/ including subfolders, excluding *.progress.json. Candidates with a boolean field (ok) are sorted newest mtime first. The first candidate wins. No candidate means todo.
rules.autoFailure: ok:false gives partial 0.5 when failedPhase is present and does not start with 'boot' (the first phase); otherwise todo. ok:true gives done.
rules.tier: Each item should carry a tier field, one of the ids in tiers (kit docs/01-LESSONS.md section 7). The report script does not read it yet; when tagging a new port's checklist, also add a per-tier subtotal to progress-report.mjs under the Playable line.

items.title: Click-icon spacing
items.evidence: Outlined icons moved +4 px: native-024 and fresh port-023 both x=143; 29 matched browser states moved exactly +4 x / 0 y. Thirty native/fresh-port comparisons give median ink-relative gap delta +1 (previous -3). Native 0x43feb0 confirms +4 drawable padding for outline flags; 0x4401c0 identifies raw GDI metrics. Baseline drawable width remains approximated by canvas advance, with a shortcut comment. Proofs: re/verification/icon-draw-comparison.json, icon-gap-after.json, icon-compare-after.json; cached REA in re/scratch/.

items.title: Inline-code waits inside text (for example the 0.5 s sprite crossfade)
items.evidence: Native 0x483680 starts a separate inline thread; 0x47f130 polls thread exit and resets the glyph timestamp at 0x47f1e4. Each batch also resets its timestamp at 0x47fda4: no fractional carry. This matches retained VM continuations; original WaitKey(500) timeout/input/save restoration and cafe proofs pass (inline-wait-compressed.json; native-fidelity rerun; rea-progress-findings.md).

items.title: Remaining `shortcut:` guesses in src (live count printed by the report)
items.evidence: Native findings resolve sound defaults and inline glyph-clock assumptions. Icon timing is traced but retains a shortcut for browser render-cadence/overload drift. Remaining markers are counted at report time; this broad item's credit is unchanged merely by lowering that count.
